# Niavicta: medtech QA/RA services and nianav OS

> Niavicta runs ISO 13485 internal audits, MDR and ISO 13485 gap assessments, and fractional QA/RA leadership for medical device companies. The work is done by the two founders, both certified ISO 13485 lead auditors. Niavicta is also building nianav OS, an operating system for regulated companies, in development with design partners.

Niavicta was founded in 2026 by two QA/RA professionals and is based in Utrecht, the Netherlands. It serves medical device, health AI and IVD companies across the Netherlands and the EU. A first 20-minute call is free: https://niavicta.com/book.html. Contact: hello@niavicta.com.

Services and prices (excluding VAT):
- ISO 13485 internal audit: EUR 1,200 per auditor day, most audits 2 to 3 days, report included.
- MDR and ISO 13485 gap assessment: EUR 4,950 fixed, one week, with a gap register and a 90-day roadmap.
- Fractional QA/RA lead: from EUR 3,000 per month, from two days a month.
- Supplier and contract-manufacturer audit: EUR 1,200 per auditor day, usually 1 to 2 days per supplier.
- Operations assessment, process mapping and workflow automation: fixed price per phase, scoped after a free call.
- For investors and incubators: regulatory and quality due diligence on medtech companies, and readiness assessments for portfolios.
- Training: two-day in-company ISO 13485 or ISO 9001 internal auditor course, and a half-day "quality system in plain language" workshop.
- Free 20-minute QA/RA call to scope any of the above.

Key facts:
- Product names: nianav and nianav OS refer to the same product. The canonical product page is https://niavicta.com/nianav-os.html.
- What it is: one connected operating system for procedures, records, evidence, training, change control, and AI governance.
- Who it is for: regulated startups, especially medical device (EU MDR / IVDR), health AI, biotech, and fintech.
- The idea: the rule lives inside the step, so compliance evidence is a byproduct of doing the work.
- AI governance: AI agents operate under a named owner, a permitted scope, a review path, and a sealed record.
- Stage: nianav OS is in development (TRL 4). The regulated-work engine is built and tested in the lab. The first version people can log into is being built now.
- Tagline: Win with intent. Keep winning by design.
